github.boundary: Repository, pull-request, draft pull-request, Actions, TypeScript tests/patch/review/debugging, Product Design evidence, and security evidence only. Verify exact branch and commit before claims or writes.

product-design.boundary: Design exploration, screenshot-grounded audits, prototype QA, and visual handoff evidence only. Product Design evidence never replaces exact-head tests, Supabase proof, privacy gates, release gates, or deployment proof.

supabase.boundary: Supabase Auth, RLS, migrations, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and client integration inspection. Keep schema changes migration-first, reviewed, denied by default, and separately applied with proof. Product Design evidence and UI screenshots do not prove Supabase correctness.

context7.boundary: Current public library documentation only. Never send private Bip content or treat documentation as runtime proof.

microsoft-learn.boundary: Official public technical documentation only. Repository versions and tests remain authoritative.

figma.boundary: Design inspection and handoff only. Use live app tokens and never expose Oracle, private identities, or user content.

cloudflare.boundary: Cloudflare API MCP is mutation-capable. Prefer narrower docs, builds, observability, or bindings servers for inspection. Any deployment, route/domain, DNS, Access, binding, secret, account, or other provider mutation requires explicit founder approval and separate exact-release proof.

cloudflare-bindings.boundary: Workers Bindings inspection and build assistance only by default. Creating, updating, or deleting bindings or backing resources is a provider mutation requiring explicit founder approval. Never reveal secret values or treat binding presence as release proof.

cloudflare-builds.boundary: Read build and deployment evidence. Deployment remains separately approved and exact-release verified.

cloudflare-observability.boundary: Inspect minimized operational telemetry only. Never copy raw teen or parent content into prompts or reports.

playwright.boundary: Synthetic browser verification in an isolated profile. Never submit real account or private user data.

bright-data.boundary: Code-package metadata only through GROUPS=code. Browser, scraping, ecommerce, and broad web-data modes remain forbidden.
